rationale: Verbal noun formation on ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'release' with nominalizing prefix ⲟⲓⲛ- (cf. ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲃⲱⲗ 'the dissolution' in accumulated vocabulary). The intercalated ⲡ̄ may represent the article. Paired here with ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲛⲟⲩⲍⲙⲉ 'salvation' as the title of the fifth cosmic-redemptive act, identified with the Great Counsel (Call+Hearing).

Greek-derived compound spanning lines 20-21 with internal lacuna. Possibly ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉⲣⲁⲣⲭⲏ 'archhierarchy', ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲁ-ⲕⲁⲑⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏ, or a hapax. Established by Jesus 'of all the churches' — fits the apostolic-foundation register. Reading remains uncertain; flagged for parallel attestations in subsequent pages.
